tns:patch.author: ginchauspe
tns:patch.description: recreate view, this will always be the last version of the view

script.lang: SELECT settingsvalue FROM amp_global_settings where settingsname='Recreate the views on the next server restart';

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_indicator_themes AS SELECT con.activity_id AS amp_activity_id, ind.name, ind.indicator_id AS me_indicator_id, t.amp_theme_id AS me_npo_id, t.amp_theme_id AS amp_theme_id, CASE ind.type WHEN 'A' THEN 1 :: BIGINT WHEN 'D' THEN 2 :: BIGINT ELSE 3 :: BIGINT END AS me_indicator_type_id, con.ind_val_category AS me_indicator_logframe_id, con.risk AS me_indicator_risk_id FROM amp_indicator_connection con JOIN amp_indicator ind ON ind.indicator_id = con.indicator_id LEFT JOIN amp_theme t ON ind.program_id = t.amp_theme_id LEFT JOIN amp_theme t2 ON t.parent_theme_id = t2.amp_theme_id WHERE con.sub_clazz::text = 'a'::text;
